公司簡介
Corporate Profile


華潤醫藥集團有限公司（股份代號：3320）是中                  China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Limited (stock code: 3320) is a leading
國領先的綜合醫藥公司，業務範疇覆蓋醫藥及                     integrated pharmaceutical company in China. Our business encompasses
保 健 產 品 的 生 產、分 銷 及 零 售。本 集 團 成 立 於      manufacturing, distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and healthcare
二零零七年，現已發展成中國前五大醫藥製造                     products. Since the establishment in 2007, the Group has developed into one
商兼中國前三大醫藥產品分銷商（按收益）。                     of the fifth largest pharmaceutical manufacturers and one of the third largest
                                         pharmaceutical distributors (by revenue) in China.

本公司於二零一六年十月在香港成功完成全球                     In October 2016, the Company successfully completed its global offering
發 售。我 們 的 製 造 業 務 涵 蓋 研 發、生 產 及 銷 售      in Hong Kong. Our manufacturing business encompasses the research and
醫藥產品。我們生產 626 種藥品，產品組合包括                 development, manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products. We
化學藥品、中藥、生物藥以及營養保健品，覆蓋                    manufacture 626 products comprising chemical drugs, Chinese medicines
廣 泛 治 療 領 域，包 括 心 血 管、消 化 道 和 新 陳 代      and biological drugs as well as nutritional and healthcare products, covering
謝、大容量靜脈注射液、兒科、呼吸系統等。此                    a wide range of therapeutic areas including cardiovascular, alimentary
外，我們擁有「999」、「東阿阿膠」、「雙鶴」、「紫               tract and metabolism, large-volume IV infusion, pediatrics, respiratory
竹」、「江中」及「博雅」等多個馳名品牌，業務覆                  system, etc. Moreover, we own a range of famous brands, such as “999”,
蓋感冒、胃腸、皮膚、兒科、骨科、血製品等品                    “Dong-E-E-Jiao”, “Double Crane”, “Zizhu”, “Jiangzhong” and “Boya”,
類，未 來 將 積 極 向 健 康 管 理、慢 病 管 理 產 品 延      covering therapeutic areas including cold, gastroenterology, dermatology,
伸，滿足中國家庭從預防、保健、治療、康復，                    pediatrics, orthopedics, plasma products, among others. In future, we will
全週期、多層次的健康需求。                            actively expand into health management and products for chronic disease
                                         management to meet the full-cycle and multi-dimensional healthcare needs of
                                         Chinese households from prevention, healthcare, therapy to recovery.

我們視研發創新為長期發展的重要驅動力，持                     We regard R&D and product innovation as important drivers for our long-term
續加大研發投入，具有五個獲國家認證的工程                     growth and consistently increase the investment in R&D activities. We operate
技術研究中心、三個獲國家認證的企業技術中                     five State-certified engineering technology research centers, three State-
心，以 及 近 50 個 獲 省 市 級 認 證 的 研 究 中 心，研     certified enterprise technology centers and approximately 50 provincially-
發人員超過 2,300 名。                           accredited research centers, with a R&D team comprising over 2,300 staff
                                         members.

憑藉我們全面的產品供應及廣泛的分銷網路，                     Leveraging our comprehensive product supply and wide distribution networks,
我們向中國的醫院及其他醫療機構直接分銷產                     we directly distribute products to hospitals and other medical institutions
品。我們經營著一個由超過 200 個物流中心構成                 across the country. We operate a national distribution network comprising
的全國性分銷網路，戰略性覆蓋中國 28 個省、                  over 200 logistics centers strategically across 28 provinces, municipalities and

董事提名政策概要                              Summary of the Director Nomination Policy
本公司了解及認同董事會具備適當的所需技巧、                 The Company recognizes and embraces the benefits of a Board with a balance
經驗及多樣的觀點與角度的裨益，考慮到提名                  of skills, experience and diversity of perspectives. Given the importance of the
委員會在其中所扮演的重要角色，為提高有關                  Nomination Committee’s role in ensuring the balance within the Board and
提名委員會就有關選舉董事的透明度及問責，                  to give greater focus and transparency in relation to the election of Directors,
本公司就此制定董事提名政策，旨在列出提名                  the Company has established the Director Nomination Policy. This policy aims
委員會在甄選、委任及再度委任董事方面的方                  to set out the approach to guide the Nomination Committee in relation to the
針，及確保董事會在技能、經驗、知識及多元化                 selection, appointment and re-appointment of the Directors, and to ensure
觀點方面取得平衡，切合本公司的業務要求。                  the Board has a balance of skills experience, knowledge and diversity of
                                      perspectives appropriate to the requirements of the Company’s business.

條件包括（但不限於）誠信及性格方面的聲譽、                 consideration to criteria including (but not limit to) reputation for character
專 業 經 驗、多 元 化 觀 點、對 董 事 會 的 職 責 的 承   and integrity, region and industry experience, diversity in aspects, commitment
擔及所付出之時間以及可以為董事會帶來的潛                  for responsibilities of the Board in respect of available time, and potential
在貢獻。                                  contributions brought to the Board.

候選人是否適合擔任董事一職之後，提名委員                  checks, presentations and third party reference checks; upon considering a

內部監控及風險管理                             INTERNAL CONTROL AND RISK MANAGEMENT
董事會明白，董事會須負責維持充分的風險管                  The Board acknowledges that it is the responsibility of the Board for
理及內部監控制度（該等風險包括（其中包括）與                maintaining an adequate risk management and internal control systems (which
本集團營運及重要環境、社會及管治相關的重                  cover, among others, significant risks concerning the Group’s operations and
大風險），以保障股東的投資及本公司的資產，                 material environmental, social and governance risks) to safeguard shareholder
並每年審閱該制度的有效性。風險管理及內部                  investments and Company assets and reviewing the effectiveness of such
監控系統可對重大錯誤陳述或損失提供合理而                  systems on an annual basis. The risk management and internal control
非絕對的保證，並旨在管理而非消除在達致業                  systems can provide reasonable and not absolute assurance against material
務目標的過程中出現的失敗風險。                       misstatement or loss and are designed to manage rather than eliminate the
                                      risk of failure in the process of attaining business objectives.

本集團已建立全面的風險管理及內部控制系統，                 The Group has established a comprehensive risk management and internal
並極為重視其製藥、醫藥分銷及藥品零售業務                  control system, and devoted significant attention to internal control measures
的內部控制措施。其已採取嚴格的內部控制措                  of its pharmaceutical manufacturing, pharmaceutical distribution and
施 及 經 營 程 式，以 監 管 從 研 發 到 生 產、分 銷 及   pharmaceutical retail businesses. It has adopted stringent internal control
零售的醫藥價值鏈各個環節。本集團內部控制                  measures and operating procedures to regulate all stages of its pharmaceutical
系統根據相關行業及管理標準（包括 GMP 及 GSP            value chain, from research and development to manufacturing, distribution
要求）設計。本集團定期實施內部控制審計、內                 and retail. The Group’s internal control system is designed according to
部風險管理及除錯防錯方面的各項程序。                    relevant industrial and management standards, including the GMP and GSP
                                      requirements. The Group implements the procedures for periodic internal
                                      control audit, internal risk management, and error correction and prevention
                                      on a regular basis.

  香 港 財 務 報 告 準 則 第 16 號 修 訂 訂 明 賣 方      Amendments to HKFRS 16 specify the requirements that a seller-
  — 承租人於計量售後回租交易中產生的                      lessee uses in measuring the lease liability arising in a sale and

      者按其最佳經濟利益行事。                 when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act

  本集團無法輕易釐定租賃內所隱含的利                   The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit in a lease,
  率，因此，使用增量借款利率（「增量借款                 and therefore, it uses an incremental borrowing rate (“IBR”) to measure
  利率」）計量租賃負債。增量借款利率為本                 lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of interest that the Group would have
  集團於類似經濟環境中為取得與使用權資                  to pay to borrow over a similar term, and with a similar security, the
  產價值相近之資產，而以類似抵押品與類                  funds necessary to obtain an asset of a similar value to the right-of-use
  似期間借入所需資金應支付之利率。因此，                 asset in a similar economic environment. The IBR therefore reflects what
  增量借款利率反映了本集團「應支付」的利                 the Group “would have to pay”, which requires estimation when no
  率，當無可觀察的利率時（如就並無訂立                  observable rates are available (such as for subsidiaries that do not enter
  融資交易之附屬公司而言）或當須對利率                  into financing transactions) or when it needs to be adjusted to reflect
  進行調整以反映租賃之條款及條件時（如                  the terms and conditions of the lease (for example, when leases are not
  當租賃並非以附屬公司之功能貨幣訂立                   in the subsidiary’s functional currency). The Group estimates the IBR
  時），則 須 作 出 利 率 估 計。當 可 觀 察 輸 入      using observable inputs (such as market interest rates) when available
  數據可用時，本集團使用可觀察輸入數據                  and is required to make certain entity-specific estimates (such as the

      至確定其可使用年期為有限期為止。相反，                      will not be amortised until the useful life is determined to be finite.
      商標會每年及當有跡象顯示可能減值時進                       Instead, they will be tested for impairment annually and whenever

  計算反映概率加權結果、貨幣時值及於報               reflects the probability-weighted outcome, the time value of money
  告日期可得的有關過往事件、現時狀況及               and reasonable and supportable information that is available at the
  未來經濟狀況預測的合理及可靠資料。                reporting date about past events, current conditions and forecasts of
                                   future economic conditions.

         若干銀行及金融機構（為政府關聯實                              including deposits placement, borrowings and other general
         體）訂立多項交易，包括存款、借款                              banking facilities, with certain banks and financial institutions

    價值層級（續）                                  OF FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS (continued)
      由財務經理領導之本集團之財務部門負責                    The Group’s finance department headed by the finance manager is
      釐定金融工具公允價值計量的政策及程序。                   responsible for determining the policies and procedures for the fair
      財務經理直接向首席財務官及審計委員會                    value measurement of financial instruments. The finance manager
      呈報。於各報告日期，財務部門分析金融                    reports directly to the chief financial officer and the audit committee. At
      工具的價值變動並釐定估值中適用的主要                    each reporting date, the finance department analyses the movements
      參數。估值由首席財務官審核及批准。                     in the values of financial instruments and determines the major inputs
                                            applied in the valuation. The valuation is reviewed and approved by the
                                            chief financial officer.

      金融資產及負債之公允價值計入自願（而                    The fair values of the financial assets and liabilities are included at
      非強迫或清盤出售）交易雙方於當前交易                    the amount at which the instrument could be exchanged in a current
      中可互換工具之金額內。於估計公允價值                    transaction between willing parties, other than in a forced or liquidation
      時，會使用下列方式及假設：                         sale. The following methods and assumptions were used to estimate
                                            the fair values:

      非流動部分的銀行借款的公允價值乃按具                    The fair values of non-current portion of bank borrowings have been
      有類似條款、信貸風險及剩餘年期的工具                    calculated by discounting the expected future cash flows using rates
      的現行利率貼現預計未來現金流量計算。                    currently available for instruments with similar terms, credit risk and
      於二零二二年十二月三十一日，本集團就                    remaining maturities. The Group’s own non-performance risk for bank
      銀行借款的不履約風險被評估為並不重大。                   borrowings as at 31 December 2022 was assessed to be insignificant.
      經考慮本集團的不履約風險，應付債券的                    The fair value of the bonds payable is estimated by discounting the
      公允價值按類似應付債券的同等市場利率                    expected future cash flows using an equivalent market interest rate
      貼現預計未來現金流量估算。                         for similar bonds payable with consideration of the Group’s own non-
                                            performance risk.

      非上市股權投資的公允價值乃採用以並無                    The fair values of unlisted equity investments have been estimated
      獲可觀察市場價格或比率支持的假設為基                    using a market-based valuation technique based on assumptions that
      礎的基於市場的估值技術估計。該估值要                    are not supported by observable market prices or rates. The valuation
      求董事根據行業、規模、槓桿及策略釐定                    requires the directors to determine comparable public companies
      可資比較上市公司（同行），並為各已識別                   (peers) based on industry, size, leverage and strategy, and calculates an
      可資比較公司計算合適價格倍數（例如企                    appropriate price multiple, such as enterprise value to earnings before
      業價值相對除利息、稅項、折舊及攤銷前                    interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (“EV/EBITDA”) multiple
      盈 利（「EV/EBITDA」）倍 數 及 市 盈 率（「市 盈      and price to earnings (“P/E”) multiple, for each comparable company
       率」）倍數）。倍數乃按可資比較公司的企                  identified. The multiple is calculated by dividing the enterprise value
      業價值除以盈利計量計算。交易倍數其後                    of the comparable company by an earnings measure. The trading
      會根據公司特定事實及環境就可資比較公                    multiple is then discounted for considerations such as illiquidity and size
      司之間存在的非流動資金及規模差異等考                    differences between the comparable companies based on company-
      慮因素進行折讓。折讓倍數應用於非上市                    specific facts and circumstances. The discounted multiple is applied to
      股權投資相應盈利計量以計算公允價值。                    the corresponding earnings measure of the unlisted equity investments
      董事相信此估計技術產生之估計公允價值                    to measure the fair value. The directors believe that the estimated fair
      （於綜合財務狀況表入賬）及相關公允價值                   values resulting from the valuation technique, which are recorded in the
      變動（於損益入賬）為合理，亦為於報告期                   consolidated statement of financial position, and the related changes
      末之最恰當價值。                              in fair values, which are recorded in profit or loss, are reasonable, and
                                            that they were the most appropriate values at the end of the reporting
                                            period.
